svg.aria-label: Gossip spreads information like a rumour. In round 1 the node that knows an update tells a few randomly chosen peers. In round 2 every informed node does the same, so the number of informed nodes roughly multiplies each round. A cluster of 1,000 nodes is fully informed in about 10 rounds, with no central server and no single point of failure; duplicated messages are harmless.
